Messages.Author: Richard Zopf
Messages.Body:
To All,
I was sitting in a cold, dark place when this variant potence Rush deck
idea came to me. It will suffer, as all potence decks do, against damage
prevention, and in an overly fast (bleed, vote) environment wherein it
doesn't get early table control... Anyway, here it is, in glorious ELDB
format

Deck name: The Amputator
Created by: R. David Zopf
Description: A fun theme variant of a stock weenie potence deck. Do more
damage than your opponent, then start pulling off appendages. Cackle madly,
and often ;-)
Crypt: (12 cards)
1 Agatha (Nosferatu Antitribu, 4, ob PO)
1 Cameron (Lasombra, 2, ot)
1 Dre, Leader of the Cold Dawn (Brujah, 3, ce po)
1 Duck (Nosferatu, 3, ob po)
1 Hasina Kesi (Caitiff, 1, po)
1 Hector Sosa (Brujah, 4, PO pr)
1 Hugo (Brujah Antitribu, 4, PO pr vi)
1 Jacob Bragg (Brujah Antitribu, 3, ce po)
1 Jimmy Dunn (Pander, 4, CE fo PO)
1 KoKo (Nosferatu, 2, po)
1 Lupo (Brujah, 2, po)
1 Tommy (Nosferatu Antitribu, 3, an po)

Library: (90 cards)
2 Blood Doll
10 Bum's Rush
2 Death of My Conscience, The
8 Decapitate
8 Disarm
3 Haven Uncovered
12 Immortal Grapple
5 Increased Strength
5 Mighty Grapple
1 Pentex(TM) Loves You!
3 Potence
6 Pulled Fangs
4 Pushing the Limit
8 Taste of Vitae
5 Thrown Sewer Lid
8 Undead Strength

A few choice pieces of equipment (Meat Cleaver, etc.) would enhance the
theme, but possibly detract from its playability. Thoughts on making either
the theme or the operation of this deck better would be appreciated.
--
Regards,
R. David Zopf
Atom Weaver (& V:EKN Prince of Charlotte, NC)
